summary_1line: King Somaka sacrifices his only son to gain a hundred sons; later he finds his priest suffering in hell for the act.

image_candidates.scene_text: The priest drags the crying boy Jantu toward the sacrificial fire while a circle of mothers clutch at him and scream in anguish.
The sacrificial fire blazes as the mothers collapse to the ground after smelling the smoke of the offering.
In the afterlife Somaka sees his family priest being scorched in a fiery hell and speaks to him across the flames.
